qualities.name: Traceability
qualities.question: Can a human reconstruct why a material state exists and what changed it?

qualities.name: Restartability
qualities.question: Can a fresh worker continue without old chat context?

qualities.name: Automation
qualities.question: Is clerical/process work automated where judgement is not required?

qualities.name: Human Explainability
qualities.question: Are evidence, uncertainty, authority, changes and consequences inspectable?

qualities.name: System Coherence
qualities.question: Are new aspects fused into existing understanding rather than appended as parallel truth?

qualities.name: Reversibility
qualities.question: Can consequential changes be reviewed, diffed and reverted?

qualities.name: Problem Fit
qualities.question: Does the solution fit the actual project need rather than generic best practice alone?

qualities.name: Proportional Complexity
qualities.question: Is complexity justified by observed need and maintenance burden?

qualities.name: Domain Integrity
qualities.question: Are domain distinctions, methods, evidence limits and uncertainty preserved?

qualities.name: Engineering Quality
qualities.question: Is implementation testable, maintainable and operationally appropriate?
